rootfs.note: Debian trixie arm64 guest, driver-tuned and capture-prepared. Gzip-compressed QCOW2 (not raw): launch with -drive ...,format=qcow2. The RX-aggregation fix (rtw_usb_rxagg_mode=0 etc) plus the 8812au blacklist are baked into /etc/modprobe.d inside this image, and the 88XXau module is prebuilt for kernel 6.12.107+deb13-arm64, so a fresh install captures data frames with no guest configuration. The capture tree /root/loot/<type>/ with a README is baked in too, so runs are organised from the first boot, and the image ships no captures, no shell history and no authorized_keys.
